sceneTitle: On the bridge of the Docs Sentient flag ship
editorText:
John stood by Doc looking out over the strange planets horizon. The stratosphere seemed to move, deceiving new eyes into believing a concoction of gases may be stirring. Although beneath the ozone 150 klm down what moved was very real. “Oasis lives in a constant state of flux, each of it's surface plates shifting like a moving ocean, exchanging in a constant symbiosis with other plates much like cells passing by in a venous system. Each with its own eco system interacting with one another giving and taking in a never ending wheel of life.” John found it hard to fathom what he was hearing trying to piece together the biology of it all, he listened quietly in marvel as the planets surface danced a slow display from outer orbit, what ensued on the surface moved much faster. Doc could see through Johns gaze for what it was, curiosity, he obliged it.

“Initially we lost many resources on our first settlement, to be expected. New species of local fauna didn't take to fondly passing through to new structures prying and investigating finding new ways to penetrate our boundaries. You would be surprised how aware some creatures are”.

In the centre of the bridge a holograph rotated above a circular well which recessed below the Ignotus’s bridge deck fitted with countless light emitting modules. The holograph emitted a light blue grow across the room drawing any occupants to its centre as it caught their eye. John found himself turning to find the massive bulbous head of a “Spychottidal” sweeping the bridge radius pass by him. “Heightened awareness, Spychottidals are genus to mineral rich plate types 346 and 348. They have been known to venture out to other plates in search of new mineral rich environments. Their heightened sensory system can be attributed to a mineral rich diet that is used in the amplification of their sensory nodules found within their hardened bulbous neural core atop an elongated body used to burrow deep down to mineral sources” John read through the creature's description gleaning deeper into the struggles faced with the Sentient colonisation.

“Spychottidal's were able to see past our improved mesh technology, we tried neural blockers and eventually found seismic barriers could only be used in several cases. Although the shifting of the plates gave us some time to recover and learn from Interactions we had to plan our resources and work around the shifts. Our expansion at times has had its setbacks environmentally where we have had to improvise, however if we keep the balance with environmental markers we read to check our presence has minimal impact on the planet itself, this means that the symbiotic tracer we leave behind and serve to gain from the existing system flourishes” John seemed impressed by what the foresight the algorithm was capable of projecting, How something made from sheer resources pulled from within a planet itself, inorganic could bolster such a profound respect for it’s or his organic counterpart. Although he knew the amalgamation before him to be his father, He couldn’t help but feel like he was something more, an entity he had created and merged with. “”
